description:
Found by the specled_-dn4.9 audit (2026-07-26T00:25:30Z) while tracing item 2's path-identity fold. This is a real defect, not a cleanup.

dn4.5 normalized the per-test lane to repo-relative path identity, and dn4.9 item 2 extended repo-relative :files into the v1 records. But the v1 file-level detectors still join those repo-relative :files / owned_files against ABSOLUTE closure_files derived from raw module_info(:compile)[:source] — see lib/mix/tasks/spec.triangle.ex:447 and lib/specled_ex/review/coverage_closure.ex:132. A repo-relative string can never equal an absolute one, so execution_reach and untested_realization can never match.

Impact: those two detectors silently report nothing rather than reporting wrongly — same silent-failure class this epic spent the day correcting on the per-test lane, now visible on the v1 lane.

Fix: extend dn4.5's per_test_path_identity normalization to the v1 path so both sides of the join agree. Verify by constructing a case that SHOULD match and asserting it does — the current tests pass because nothing ever matches.

comments.text: Base decision: the defect only exists on the dn4 epic branch (specled_-dn4/fast-follow-per-test) — main's Formatter.source_file/1 still stores absolute paths, so the v1 join works on main. dn4.9 item 2's repo_relative_path in formatter.ex is what broke the join, and the fix must extend repo_relative_source_path (dn4.5 lane), which doesn't exist on main. Staging from epic HEAD ddda892; fix ships with the epic, never reaching main broken.

Tests added: Mix.Tasks.SpecTriangleTest "per_test execution_reach joins repo-relative record files against closure compile sources" (asserts execution_reach: 1/1 — the SHOULD-match case; 0/1 before fix); SpecLedEx.Review.CoverageClosureTest "closure_files in the reach closure map are repo-root-relative" (via the documented per_test_reach_fn seam — closure_files is otherwise unobservable from build_v2 output). Red-green proven: both fail with lib changes stashed, pass with them.

Verification tier: change-scoped — mix test --stale (post-rebase this ran the full host suite: 1238 tests, 0 failures), both touched test files + coverage_triangulation_test.exs targeted, mix format --check-formatted, mix compile --warnings-as-errors, mix spec.check --no-run-commands --base HEAD~1 => spec.check result=pass; full-system proof deferred to the epic merge gate / PR CI
Final-tier runs: 2 (first spec.check run failed on branch-guard decision/subject findings; cleared with Spec-Drift info trailers per repo convention — this is a behavior repair, not durable policy, so no ADR)

Summary: Both v1 mfa_source_file/1 producers (spec.triangle and Review.CoverageClosure) now resolve module compile sources to the same repo-root-relative identity as coverage-record :file values (mirroring CoverageTriangulation.repo_relative_source_path/1), dropping out-of-repo sources instead of emitting absolute paths no record can equal. This makes the execution_reach/untested_realization joins able to match, satisfying the existing triangulation requirement statements (no spec change needed — the code was violating them). untested_realization shares the exact exercised_files/closure join the reach test pins; its per-test findings currently have no live renderer beyond the public findings/3 contract.
NOTE: base decision — the defect exists only on the dn4 epic branch (main's formatter still writes absolute record files), so this landed on a stage cut from epic HEAD; merge-back target is the epic branch, and the epic branch was concurrently rebased onto main at 20:44 (stage already reset onto bfced80).

title: v1 file-level detectors can never match: repo-relative :files joined against absolute closure_files
